scientific_limitations: Only the right derivative of absorption-time quantiles at zero Poisson-reset rate is classified; no global optimum is determined.
The existence construction may require very widely separated starting-distance classes.
Brownian half-line absorption with one diffusivity, independently resetting particles, and resets to each particle own fixed starting distance is assumed.
The main recent primary preprint was accessible only at abstract level; detailed publication priority relative to its uninspected sections remains uncertain.
Finite numerical checks are not a proof of the arbitrary-K theorem.
title: Arbitrarily many alternating rank bands under heterogeneous Brownian resetting
